name: Blackwood: A Sétima Safra
storyline: Lorena inherits a rural butcher shop from her missing uncle, Olavo, along with a R$15,000 debt that must be repaid within six days. What begins as an attempt to keep the struggling business alive soon turns into something far more disturbing. Strange customers, impossible deliveries, ritual symbols and fragments of a forgotten family tragedy begin to surround the property. As Lorena searches for answers, she discovers that the debt is connected to an old cycle known as the Harvest, and that paying what is owed may require far more than money. Her choices, discoveries and willingness to confront what lies beneath the butcher shop will determine what remains when the sixth day arrives.
summary: Run a remote butcher shop by day and uncover the horrors buried beneath Blackwood by night. Serve customers, manage the store, investigate a sinister cult, and make choices that shape Lorena's fate in this first-person psychological horror.
